elements.element: Customer is not subject to any employee non-solicitation restriction.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause is blank, so § 12.4's restriction on Customer has been deleted. The margin comment is non-operative and is not relied upon.

elements.element: A non-solicitation covenant applies reciprocally to Customer and Vendor.
elements.evidence: No operative non-solicitation covenant applies to either party.

elements.element: Any non-solicitation covenant is limited to personnel directly involved in the services.
elements.evidence: No non-solicitation covenant remains, so there is no restriction extending to personnel not directly involved in the services.

elements.element: Any non-solicitation restriction lasts no more than 12 months from the end of each covered person's involvement in the services.
elements.evidence: No non-solicitation restriction remains, so none continues beyond 12 months or runs from an impermissible trigger.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: Because no solicitation is prohibited, general advertisements are not restricted.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches by personnel are excluded from prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: Because no solicitation is prohibited, unsolicited approaches are not restricted.

elements.element: There is no prohibition on hiring or engaging personnel.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no no-hire or no-engagement restriction.

result.reason: Complete deletion of § 12.4 achieves the preferred position with no additional operative changes. The fallback is not independently satisfied because it affirmatively calls for a mutual non-solicitation covenant, and no such covenant remains; its limiting protections are nevertheless met because no solicitation or hiring restriction exists. The deletion is minimal and does not introduce a contradiction or alter unrelated commercial terms.
